• 1. Parsing Input (String → Decimal): - Decimal.Parse(txtIn.Text) extracts numeric values from raw text strings. - Preserves exact decimal precision, making it essential for financial and currency logic.
• 2. Explicit Casting (Narrowing): - Convert.ToInt32() explicitly casts floating values into a 32-bit integer. - Decimal fractions are rounded off to the nearest whole integer, risking minor precision loss.
• 3. Implicit Casting (Widening): - Automatically converts narrower types (Integer) into wider precision containers (Double). - Handled directly by the runtime engine with zero risk of truncation or data loss.
